A recognized extra field: a directory entry with Unix mode 0755. When parsed back, Commons Compress restores it to an {@link AsiExtraField}.
An unrecognized extra field carrying a single data byte. When parsed back, Commons Compress represents it as an {@link UnrecognizedExtraField}.
The two fields above serialized into a single raw extra-field block.
